description: Luxury & Space near the Champs-Élysées - Ideal for up to 10 People!A few steps from the Champs-Élysées avenue, discover this superb spacious 150 m² apartment that perfectly combines the charm of Parisian architecture and modern comfort. Designed to accommodate up to 10 people, it is ideal for large families or groups of friends.The vast living room is a perfect space for relaxation, enhanced by a lovely balcony offering an unobstructed view of Jean Mermoz Street.The spaceLuxury & Space near the Champs-Élysées - Ideal for up to 10 People!A few steps from the Champs-Élysées avenue, discover this superb spacious 150 m² apartment that perfectly combines the charm of Parisian architecture and modern comfort. Designed to accommodate up to 10 people, it is ideal for large families or groups of friends.The vast living room is a perfect space for relaxation, enhanced by a lovely balcony offering an unobstructed view of Jean Mermoz Street. Upon request, you will find two additional single beds, complementing the sleeping arrangements (increasing from 8 to 10 sleeping spaces). The fully equipped open kitchen invites you to discover Parisian culinary pleasures, while the dining room becomes the ideal place for convivial moments.With four generously proportioned bedrooms, each with its own storage space, this apartment includes a master suite with a private bathroom. The other bedrooms have separate showers and toilets, combining comfort and privacy. An additional sofa bed is also available to maximize your hosting capacity.Immerse yourself in absolute comfort with sumptuous sofas that welcome you after a day of discoveries. Whether you are on a business trip or a family getaway, this luxurious property guarantees you a memorable experience in the City of Light.Other things to noteI
